applicability: C750 and all later nested cohorts preserving an M1 lexical historical baseline
boundary: M1 source-preserving stability; canonical enterprise semantic integration not claimed

tests.name: Identity isolation
requires: exact old/new cohort membership
per-binding source/hash/run integrity
zero source ID or binding namespace collisions
tests.expected: zero incompatible namespace collisions and zero original-source reassignment

tests.name: No false merge/split
requires: full-schema, source+locator-aware old/new/combined multiset comparison both directions
retained duplicate occurrence multiplicity
negative-control unit fixture that demonstrably fails on key collapse
tests.expected: zero lost, multiplied or coalesced occurrences; negative-control failure detected

tests.name: Historical projection
requires: C750 projection onto frozen previous binding/run/source population
field/record/lineage multiset comparison versus frozen version-0 snapshot both directions
new cohort projection comparison versus verified new outputs
tests.expected: zero old projection differences, zero new projection differences

tests.name: FIN noninterference
requires: FIN_001 2/2 on baseline and combined candidate
FIN_002 1/1 and wrong-equity negative control
exact numeric fixture and 13 frozen lineage witnesses in both environments
tests.expected: same exact fixture amounts, zero economic differences and zero historical witness differences

tests.name: Execution completeness
requires: eligible new-binding manifest
per-binding COMPLETE receipts and hashes
zero missing/extra terminal outcomes

tests.name: Frozen historical preservation
requires: unchanged old snapshot identities, versions and output fingerprints
historical processing replay count
tests.expected: no unexpected historical processing replay and zero data mutation

tests.name: Recovery and idempotency
requires: checkpoint reuse and authoritative receipt hashes
failed job and resumed job logs where relevant
exclusive publication and final exact Delta readback
tests.expected: zero duplicate processing of successful checkpoints and zero duplicate output effects

tests.name: Operational threshold acceptance
requires: actual wall time and throughput for processing, CLEAN and QUERYABLE
checkpoint/retry and human review counts
available resource, cost and DBU telemetry or explicit unavailability
owner-accepted prospective runtime limits or pre-existing configured hard timeouts
tests.expected: all declared budgets met with measured evidence, no unexplained missing phase; absent optional provider metrics explicitly disclosed

promotion_scope: C_M1_SOURCE_PRESERVING_PASS only when all required C2/C3 tests and A/B2/C1/FIN V2 PASS
enterprise_scope: No canonical business-key selection/entity resolution or enterprise semantics PASS
